summary: Language learning gamified — where habit-forming daily streaks and mascot culture beat raw LLM translation capability.
moat: While AI tutors speak fluent language, Duolingo's moat is dopamine engineering: over 30 million daily active users learn not because it is the smartest teacher, but because streaks, leagues, and push notifications keep them showing up every day.

challengers.name: ChatGPT Voice Mode & TalkPal AI
challengers.evidence: Low-latency conversational voice bots allow free-flowing spoken language practice with native accent feedback.
